messages.author: alex
messages.text: How do we handle refunds for Stripe Connect accounts? The docs say something about reverse transfers but I'm not clear on the timing.

messages.author: sam
messages.text: You need to create a Refund object on the PaymentIntent first, then reverse the transfer separately. The transfer reversal can take 5-7 business days.

messages.author: alex
messages.text: Got it, thanks! That cleared it up.

messages.author: jordan
messages.text: What's our recommended connection pool size for Postgres? We keep hitting max connections in staging.

messages.author: taylor
messages.text: We use PgBouncer in transaction mode with a pool of 25 per app instance. Max connections on the DB is 200. If you're still hitting limits, check for connection leaks in your async code.

messages.author: jordan
messages.text: Found the leak — we weren't closing connections in the error path. Fixed now.

messages.author: casey
messages.text: Does our API return Retry-After headers when rate limited? I'm getting 429s with no guidance.

messages.author: morgan
messages.text: Yes — X-RateLimit-Reset and Retry-After are both returned. If you're not seeing them, you might be hitting the WAF limit before the app limit. Check the response headers carefully; WAF responses look different.

messages.author: casey
messages.text: Ah that was it — WAF limit. Thanks Morgan.

messages.author: riley
messages.text: Our Docker builds are taking 8 minutes every time. Any tips for improving layer caching?

messages.author: quinn
messages.text: Put your dependency installation (requirements.txt, package.json) before your source copy. Also use BuildKit mount caches for apt and pip.

messages.author: riley
messages.text: BuildKit mount cache cut it to 2 minutes. Huge win.

messages.author: drew
messages.text: What happens to in-flight requests when Redis cluster fails over? Do they get retried or dropped?

messages.author: blake
messages.text: Dropped by default. We wrap Redis calls in a 3-retry loop with 100ms backoff. For critical paths, use a circuit breaker that falls back to DB reads.

messages.author: drew
messages.text: Good call on the circuit breaker. Adding that now.

messages.author: jules
messages.text: Anyone done a strict mode migration on a large TS codebase? We have 400+ errors after flipping the switch.

messages.author: avery
messages.text: Don't fix them all at once. Use tsconfig's incremental strict flags — noImplicitAny first, then strictNullChecks. We did it over 3 sprints and it was manageable.

messages.author: jules
messages.text: Smart approach. Starting with noImplicitAny this sprint.

messages.author: kris
messages.text: What's our standard rollout strategy for new features? Do we do percentage-based or user-segment based?

messages.author: dakota
messages.text: Internal team first (dogfood), then 5% of paying customers, then 25%, then GA. We use LaunchDarkly for the gating. Always have a kill switch ready.

messages.author: kris
messages.text: Kill switch is key. Thanks Dakota.

messages.author: skyler
messages.text: How long should we run A/B tests? Is there a formula we use?

messages.author: reese
messages.text: Minimum 2 weeks to account for weekly seasonality. We use a sample-size calculator with 80% power and 5% significance. If the uplift is < 2%, you need ~10k per variant.

messages.author: skyler
messages.text: 10k per variant — noted. Thanks Reese.

messages.author: tatum
messages.text: Do we use self-hosted runners for anything? The public runners are timing out on our integration tests.

messages.author: cameron
messages.text: Yes — we have 4 self-hosted runners on EC2 for the heavy integration suite. They're in the `heavy` runner group. Tag your workflow with `runs-on: self-hosted` and `group: heavy`.

messages.author: tatum
messages.text: Perfect, will tag it. Thanks.

messages.author: sage
messages.text: What's our pattern for WebSocket reconnection? Should we use exponential backoff or fixed interval?

messages.author: hayden
messages.text: Exponential backoff with jitter, capped at 30s. After 5 failed reconnects, show a 'connection lost' UI state and let the user manually retry. Don't auto-reconnect forever — it burns battery and looks like the app is 'working' when it's not.

messages.author: sage
messages.text: The cap and manual retry makes sense. Will implement.
